description: This file defines a Lightning.js component named 'Home' using the Blits framework. It includes component imports, a template with visual elements, and lifecycle hooks. The component manages states such as logo position, rotation, scale, loader and text opacity, and color cycling, orchestrating animations and interactions on the 'Home' page.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A Lightning.js component acting as the home page layout with animated logo, loader, and button components.

methods.name: rotateColors
methods.description: Cycles through preset colors array at specified interval, updating the 'color' state to animate color transitions.
